title: EnTrust: Modeling Inter-Modal Conflict for Trustworthy Multimodal Medical Image Analysis
authors: Dwarikanath Mahapatra, Abhijit Das, Behzad Bozorgtabar, Zongyuan Ge, Sudipta Roy, Deepak Nayak, Mauricio Reyes, Imran Razzak
summary: EnTrust separates shared anatomy, modality-specific cues, and inter-modal conflict. A diffusion-based segmentation model uses these signals to express uncertainty where imaging modalities disagree.

figure.caption: Figure 2 · EnTrust architecture

title: PROTON: Prototype-Based Test-Time Online OOD Detection for Medical VLMs
authors: Abhijit Das, Nichula Wasalathilaka, Yifan Lu, Adinath Dukre, Dwarikanath Mahapatra, Shadab Khan, Imran Razzak
summary: PROTON maintains an online prototype bank from high-confidence test predictions and combines prototype distance with concept-matching scores to detect distribution shifts.

figure.caption: Figure 2 · PROTON architecture
figure.alt: Frozen vision-language encoders connect to an online prototype bank, a confidence gate and adaptive out-of-distribution scoring.

authors: Nichula Wasalathilaka, Abhijit Das, Imran Razzak, Dwarikanath Mahapatra
